result.description: TranscriptAPI: hosted REST API and MCP server for YouTube transcripts, video/channel/playlist data and search.
result.auth_detail: REST API: API key (sk_ prefix) sent as Authorization Bearer header. MCP server also supports OAuth 2.1 for Claude/ChatGPT clients.
result.access_detail: Self-serve signup with verified email. 100 free credits, no card required. Paid plans from about $5/month for 1,000 credits (pricing tiers from summarized page, not verbatim). 402 when out of credits.
result.api_notes: 13 GET endpoints under /api/v2: transcript, video info/metadata, search, channel resolve/info/search/videos/playlists/posts/sections/latest, playlist videos. Read-only. Swagger UI at /swagger. Credit-based billing, 1 credit per call, charged on HTTP 200.

evidence.quote: Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP — at scale.
The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the `Authorization` header of every request:
New accounts get 100 free credits with no card required.
The YouTube Transcript API provides a simple and reliable way to extract transcripts from YouTube videos programmatically.
TranscriptAPI runs a hosted (remote) MCP server at `https://transcriptapi.com/mcp`.
